Sustainability
Sustainability
Sustainability

We are continuously leading the industry in promoting sustainable development. To reduce carbon emissions, our team actively seeks various solutions from different perspectives to enhance the overall energy efficiency of the properties, achieving energy conservation and carbon reduction.

Our Commitment

We are upholding "Together,We move Sustainably Forward" as the principle of sustainability, and considering five factors in decision making, including our environment, employees, customers, supply chain and the community.

Read more

Kai Shing has set the following targets regarding environment management:

Environment
We actively take initiatives to protect the environment and implement different environmental protection solutions according to actual circumstances of our properties. Our commitment is to reduce environmental pollution and implement environmental management work in compliance with all relevant laws and regulations.
Employee
We provide appropriate training on environmental management to our employees, to ensure their understanding of environmental work and raise their awareness of environmental issues. Additionally, we have also established a quality monitoring mechanism to ensure that employees effectively apply environmental measures in their work.
Customer
We aim at preventing and minimizing pollution generated by properties, and achieving energy-saving goals through a series of environmental management such as reducing pollution, waste, electricity consumption and water usage, thus safeguarding the living environment for our customers.
Supply Chain
We join hands with our suppliers, contractors, residents, and tenants, to promote environmental messages and implement environmental programmes.
Community
We strengthen the management of relevant measures and conduct periodic reviews and revisions to ensure that all environmental schemes are operating effectively, flexibly and consistently. We strive for continuous improvement in the quality of environmental management to benefit the community.

Innovation

We actively introduce various new technology to property management to increase the operation efficiency and service quality.

Read more

As a pioneer in providing property management services, we actively integrate various innovative technologies into the daily management of properties, providing customer new experiences and bringing the operation efficiency and service quality to a higher level.

Environmental Protection

We consider environmental protection as an integral part of our property management services. We constantly improve our policies in environmental protection, energy saving and waste reduction, to ensure the effectiveness, flexibility and sustainability of operation, aiming to improve the quality of the environment. Additionally, we constantly collaborate with our suppliers, contractors, residents and tenants, to raise awareness of environmental protection in the community through different programmes.

Read more
Social Responsibility

As a property management service company upholds “People Focus”, Kai Shing is dedicated to the community and committed to discharge its social responsibilities. Over the years, we have collaborated with various groups and charitable organisations to implement many community programmes to give back to the society.
